NewsArticle.Title: Library of Loures
NewsArticle.Content:
Library of Loures appears. Discover it within Loures Castle. It will cover the subjects
King Bruce's sagacious councillor, Jean, requests that recognized Aislings scribe their work from the web version of the Library to the in-game version. Within the library will be bulletin boards which only Village or greater recognized Bards, Historians, Lorekeepers, or Philosophers may enter articles. Aisling Bards, Historians, Lorekeepers, or Philosophers have librarian priveleges to edit and remove articles.
The Library of Loures has also been visible since Deoch 1, on the web: [www.darkages.com/atavism](http://www.darkages.com/atavism) The artwork, music, and other sections could not apply to the Library within Loures Castle.
